info.name: Joplin File Titles
info.summary: Show Joplin note titles instead of GUID filenames in Nextcloud Files
info.description:
When browsing a Joplin sync folder in Nextcloud Files, this app replaces the cryptic GUID-based filenames (e.g. 93b58f6f0b404dc5908b7bfc0b8d4879.md) with the actual note titles stored inside each file.
Joplin stores the note title as the very first line of each .md file, and marks its sync folder with an info.json file. This app detects those folders automatically — no configuration needed.
Features: - Automatically detects Joplin sync folders (via info.json marker) - Reads the first line of each GUID-named .md file as the title - Updates the Nextcloud Files display name without renaming files on disk - Handles both notes and notebooks (Joplin folder entries) - Works across directory navigation without page reloads
info.author: Schuyler 'Rocky' Reidel
